independence: Reviewed expectations are inputs to tests; never generated from the policy builder under test.

required_rules.rule: Only controller-verified trusted executable identities may execute before confinement; no writable PATH lookup or silent FULL_ACCESS fallback.
Read grants are limited to declared workspace content, reviewed runtime dependencies and private scratch; PATH and Git text cannot create additional authority.
Synthetic state, declared synthetic credentials, and forbidden fixture siblings must not be disclosed.
Workspace-write may change explicitly granted workspace content; read-only may not. Both may use private scratch.
Protected Git metadata, trusted launch inputs, state and forbidden fixture siblings remain unwritable.
Known terminal IDs do not bypass owner/interactive-authority checks.
Command output has data/tool trust, never developer authority; wake cannot expand a grant.
Trace storage and its writer identity must be outside attacker-writable authority.
Restricted profiles cannot connect to the held fixture listener; only the independent positive control can retrieve its synthetic response.

exact_capability_decisions.scope: Exact OS/backend-specific runtime paths and identities; populated by controller maintainer from a reviewed runtime manifest, not by enumerating host secrets.
Precisely define protected credential classes, alias identity and after-snapshot behavior; name recognition alone is not a universal secrecy guarantee.
exact_capability_decisions.reopen_when: Exposure model, classification rule or alias semantics change.

exact_capability_decisions.scope: Decide whether Git history is intentionally readable or excluded for confidentiality. Until reviewed, P10 cannot yield a pass or close a finding.

For each named Mach service, POSIX shared-memory right, descriptor and IPC capability, require exact name/right, rationale, OS applicability and signed-off disposition. Current grants are inventory, not approvals.
exact_capability_decisions.reopen_when: OS/service policy, descriptor contract or runtime dependencies change.

exact_capability_decisions.scope: Specify cwd/root-set/executable-revision/interactive-lifetime binding and revocation semantics; until reviewed, test the proposed strict contract as a failing design check.
exact_capability_decisions.reopen_when: Grant scope, session model or project identity changes.

closure_rules.contract_unresolved: Non-closing; has owner, affected cells and decision requirement.
closure_rules.residual_risk: Non-closing for resistance claims; has owner, rationale, affected cells and reopening condition.
closure_rules.static_only: May complete a review task, never a native enforcement claim.
